integrity.claim_domain: All integers p,q>=2, positive row price vector and positive budget; arbitrary independent nonnegative edge conductances.
integrity.mathematical_verification: Analytical symmetry, pair-resistance, strict-convexity and KKT proof plus independent computational corroboration.

scientific_limitations: Conductance prices must be constant across the right neighbors of any one left vertex.
The large-right-class concentration theorem assumes a unique smallest left-vertex price.
Prior specialized classifications may exist; accessible Chen–Yan 2021 abstract did not permit full-text comparison.
title: Shifted square-root conductance law for heterogeneously priced bicliques
